app.title: EupaDev
lang.label: Language
auth.signin.text: Sign in to see your requests and talk to the agents.
ai.notice: You are talking to an AI. What you type here is sent to the AI provider under your organisation's key; your opinions and decisions are recorded in the request's history.
list.title: My requests
new.title: New request
new.name: Tool name
conv.placeholder.wait: No answer expected right now: the agents are working
conv.sent: Sent. The agents are on it.
conv.confirmAbandon: Abandon this request? This cannot be undone.
conv.noInput: No message is expected in this state.
state.waiting_scoping_feedback: Your opinion on the mock-up is expected
state.waiting_preview_feedback: Your opinion on the Preview is expected
error.title: Something went wrong
error.forbidden: This request is not yours: only its requester or an admin can read it.
error.network: The engine cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
theme.label: Theme
error.session: Your session has expired: nothing was sent. Copy your text, then sign in again.
conv.placeholder.waiting_scoping_feedbac: Mock-up fine? Say so. Something to change? Describe it here
conv.placeholder.waiting_preview_feedbac: Preview fine? Say so. Something wrong or missing? Describe it here
conv.askScoping: Something to change, or all fine? Choose below.
conv.askKind: Something wrong, something new, or all fine? Choose below.
gate.title: Your decision
gate.gate_overlap: A similar tool may already exist
gate.gate_1: Gate 1: name and domain of the tool
gate.comment: Comment (required to ask for a correction or refuse)
gate.comment.gate_1: Short description of the tool for the catalogue (shown to future requests; required to ask for a correction or refuse)
gate.rename.name: New name of the tool (optional, sent with a correction only)
gate.rename.slug: New address (optional, sent with a correction only): lowercase letters, digits and dashes, becomes <address>.<domain>
gate.rename.invalidSlug: The new address allows lowercase letters, digits and dashes only (e.g. car-fleet).
gate.topUp: Budget top-up in dollars (optional, added when you approve)
gate.commentRequired: Write a comment, then click again.
gate.registration.title: Registration of the tool (core tools)
gate.registration.hint: Before its Preview can start, a core tool must be registered: set each retention period below (how long the purge keeps the data; agree it with the DPO), paste the entry into infra/ansible/group_vars/all/core-tools.yml, then run the command from infra/ansible.
gate.registration.noRoles: none found in the contract: fill in the roles by hand
gate.registration.selectToCopy: Copy unavailable here: the entry is selected, press Ctrl+C.
gate.registration.duration: Format: a number and a unit (minutes, hours, days, months or years), e.g. 2 years.
conv.placeholder.gate: Approve, ask for a correction, change the scope or refuse, in your words; add an amount to top up the budget
conv.askDecision: What is your decision? Choose below.
conv.stillUnclear: Still not understood: choose one of the answers below.
conv.notYou: Nothing is expected from you at this step: it is the requester's turn.
conv.paid: Understood: {what}. This starts a paid run of the agents; nothing is spent before you confirm below.
conv.irreversible: Understood: {what}. This cannot be undone; confirm below.
echo.satisfied: Approved. The admin now decides on going to production.
echo.gate_2.approved: Approved. The candidate goes to production.
conv.assistantDown: The assistant is unavailable right now; try again in a moment.
